quranTranslation.text: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo svaku stvar s mjerom stvorili“ – خَلَقَ i mjera (qadar) u istom ajetu.
explanation.en: “We have created every thing by measure” — خَلَقَ and measure (qadar) in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.

explanation.bs: Čovjeka je stvorio od kapi – خَلَقَ i za stvaranje iz nečega.
explanation.en: He created man from a drop — خَلَقَ also of making from something.

quranTranslation.text: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

explanation.bs: Zemlju vam je učinio posteljom, a nebo svodom – stvorenom je dato stanje i svrha.
explanation.en: He made the earth a bed for you and the sky a canopy — created things given a state and a purpose.

quranTranslation.text: And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve?

explanation.bs: Od vas samih vam je dao žene – stvaranje nečega iz nečega.
explanation.en: He has made for you mates from yourselves — making one thing from another.

quranTranslation.text: And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary, (saying): Take as your place of worship the place where Abraham stood (to pray). And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).

explanation.bs: Kuću smo učinili utočištem ljudima – postojećoj stvari dato je novo značenje.
explanation.en: We made the House a place of return for people — an existing thing given a new standing.

quranTranslation.text: So set thy purpose (O Muhammad) for religion as a man by nature upright - the nature (framed) of Allah, in which He hath created man. There is no altering (the laws of) Allah's creation. That is the right religion, but most men know not -

explanation.bs: Allahova فِطْرَة, prema kojoj je ljude stvorio – glagol i imenica iz istog korijena: narav s kojom čovjek dolazi na svijet.
explanation.en: Allah's fiṭra upon which He originated mankind — verb and noun from one root: the nature a person is born with.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth, as one by nature upright, and I am not of the idolaters.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Ja sam lice svoje okrenuo Onome koji je stvorio nebesa i Zemlju“ – فَطَرَ: Onaj koji je sve prvi put stvorio.
explanation.en: Abraham: “I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth” — فَطَرَ: the One who first brought all into being.

quranTranslation.text: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?

explanation.bs: „A kako da ne služim Onome koji me je stvorio“ – فَطَرَ za vlastito stvaranje.
explanation.en: “For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me” — فَطَرَ for one's own creation.

quranTranslation.text: Or were ye present when death came to Jacob, when he said unto his sons: What will ye worship after me? They said: We shall worship thy god, the god of thy fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac, One Allah, and unto Him we have surrendered.

explanation.bs: „Tvome Bogu i Bogu tvojih očeva, Ibrahima, Ismaila i Ishaka“ – Ismail, Jakubov amidža, među ‚očevima‘.
explanation.en: “Thy god, the god of thy fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac” — Ishmael, Jacob's uncle, among the ‘fathers’.

quranTranslation.text: And when it is said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: We follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though their fathers were wholly unintelligent and had no guidance?

explanation.bs: „Slijedimo ono na čemu smo zatekli svoje očeve“ – آبَاء kao predaja.
explanation.en: “We follow that wherein we found our fathers” — آبَاء as tradition.

quranTranslation.text: And he placed his parents on the dais and they fell down before him prostrate, and he said: O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream of old. My Lord hath made it true, and He hath shown me kindness, since He took me out of the prison and hath brought you from the desert after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren. Lo! my Lord is tender unto whom He will. He is the Knower, the Wise.

explanation.bs: Jusuf je roditelje (أَبَوَيْهِ) popeo na prijesto – tefsir se razilazi: otac i majka, ili otac i tetka (majčina sestra).
explanation.en: Joseph raised his parents (أَبَوَيْهِ) upon the throne — tafsir differs: father and mother, or father and maternal aunt.

quranTranslation.text: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

explanation.bs: „I da roditeljima činite dobro“ – وَالِدَيْن uz zapovijed da se samo Allahu ibadet čini.
explanation.en: “And (that ye show) kindness to parents” — وَالِدَيْن beside the command to worship none but Allah.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! Keep your duty to your Lord and fear a Day when the parent will not be able to avail the child in aught, nor the child to avail the parent. Lo! Allah's promise is the very truth. Let not the life of the world beguile you, nor let the deceiver beguile you, in regard to Allah.

explanation.bs: Dan kada roditelj neće moći pomoći djetetu svome – وَالِد i وَلَد, rađanje u prvom planu.
explanation.en: A Day when no parent will avail his child — وَالِد and وَلَد, begetting in view.

quranTranslation.text: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).

explanation.bs: Naložili smo čovjeku da roditeljima dobro čini; majka ga je s mukom nosila i s mukom rodila.
explanation.en: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents; his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship.

quranTranslation.text: Is he who is a believer like unto him who is an evil-liver? They are not alike.

explanation.bs: „Pa zar je vjernik isti kao onaj ko je fasik (فَاسِق)? Ne izjednačuju se!“ – ar-Rāġib: suprotstavljen vjeri.
explanation.en: “Is he who is a believer like unto him who is an evil-liver (فَاسِق)? They are not alike” — ar-Rāġib: set against faith.

gloss.bs: fasik, onaj koji izlazi iz granica vjere

quranTranslation.text: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -

explanation.bs: Oni koji potvore čestite žene, a ne dovedu četiri svjedoka, „upravo su oni fasici (فَاسِقُون)“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Those who accuse chaste women and do not produce four witnesses — “They indeed are evil-doers (فَاسِقُون)”; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: fasik, onaj koji izlazi iz granica vjere

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

explanation.bs: „Ako vam fasik (فَاسِق) donese kakvu vijest, provjerite je.“
explanation.en: “If an evil-liver (فَاسِق) bring you tidings, verify it.”

gloss.bs: fasik, onaj koji izlazi iz granica vjere

quranTranslation.text: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

explanation.bs: „A razvratnici (فُجَّار) će, zaista, u ognju biti“ – iza 82:13, gdje su dobri (أَبْرَار) u blagodatima; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And lo! the wicked (فُجَّار) verily will be in hell” — after 82:13, where the righteous (أَبْرَار) are in delight; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: razvratnik, onaj koji razdire zastor vjere

quranTranslation.text: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?

explanation.bs: „Ili zar ćemo bogobojazne učiniti kao razvratnike (فُجَّار)?“
explanation.en: “Or shall We treat the pious as the wicked (فُجَّار)?”

gloss.bs: razvratnik, onaj koji razdire zastor vjere

quranTranslation.text: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.

explanation.bs: „Oni su ti nevjernici, ti razvratnici (فَجَرَة)“ – nevjerstvo i razvrat zajedno; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Those are the disbelievers, the wicked (فَجَرَة)” — unbelief and wickedness together; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: razvratnik, onaj koji razdire zastor vjere

quranTranslation.text: And whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger and transgresseth His limits, He will make him enter Fire, where he will dwell for ever; his will be a shameful doom.

explanation.bs: „A ko se protivi (يَعْصِ) Allahu i Njegovom Poslaniku i prelazi Njegove granice…“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And whoso disobeyeth (يَعْصِ) Allah and His messenger and transgresseth His limits…” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded.

explanation.bs: O melekima nad vatrom: „koji se ne protive (لَا يَعْصُونَ) Allahu u onome što im naredi“ – poslušnost suprotno neposlušnosti.
explanation.en: Of the angels over the Fire: “who resist not (لَا يَعْصُونَ) Allah in that which He commandeth them” — obedience as the opposite.

quranTranslation.text: What! Now! When hitherto thou hast rebelled and been of the wrong-doers?

explanation.bs: Faraonu u času utapanja: „Zar tek sada, a ranije si bio neposlušan (عَصَيْتَ)?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: To Pharaoh as he drowned: “What! Now! When hitherto thou hast rebelled (عَصَيْتَ)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
